problem: Code-edit tool details rendered patches and before/after payloads as undifferentiated gray monospaced text, making changes difficult to review.
solution: Added bounded unified-diff parsing, apply-patch detection, structured old/new extraction, line-number tracking, and a shared Claude-style SwiftUI diff surface with green additions, red deletions, accented hunks, copy support, raw-detail fallback, and local plus BrowserOS tool-card integration.
lesson: A coding-agent diff needs semantic parsing before coloring. Credible envelope detection prevents ordinary code from being misclassified, while a bounded LCS makes common before/after edit payloads reviewable without risking unbounded memory.
